pre_registration.purpose: Verify if phase alignment gates diffusion capacity to distinguish H_operator from H_scalar.

hypotheses.H_scalar: Signal propagation depends on amplitude V only (V[M] is constant over delta_phi).
hypotheses.H_operator: Signal propagation depends on both V and phi (V[M] drops to 0 when delta_phi approaches +/- pi).

pre_registration.kill_criterion: If V[M] at delta_phi = +/- pi exceeds 10% of V[M] at delta_phi = 0, the operator-i phase-gating conjecture is KILLED.

verdict.rationale: Leakage ratio at delta_phi = +/- pi is 0.00%, which is below the 10.0% threshold.
